name: Yukine
source:
Color: Blue

Likes: Watching Clouds,Books
Dislikes: Questions,Dryness

If you Climb a Hill and find a Blue-Eyed and Blue-Haired Girl Watching Clouds there,it will be Yukine. She avoids people and so it's easy to find her On Lonely places with a view of sky,Because  Clouds Cause are the thing Yukine looks for. She doesn't stay at home much,which highly Contrasts with her pale skin. Maybe it's because when outside you will find her either in water or when it's cloudy. Sometimes you can catch her reading a book,But she doesn't like Questions about it's Contents and so she will Usually Hide it.
